scope: Fictional gallery script; not a live interaction pack

activities.title: Explore a letter
activities.description: A tactile discovery, woven into the story.
activities.narrator_line: Peter has curious paws. Feel r with him—the first letter of rabbit.
activities.reason: First encounter with r in this passage.
activities.feedback: A little discovery with Peter. On we go!

activities.title: Name the letter
activities.description: One answer, then back to Peter’s adventure.
activities.narrator_line: Peter needs your help. Which letter can you feel?
activities.reason: Recall practice for the checkpoint target r.
activities.feedback: You found r! Peter is ready to hop on.

activities.title: Find its match
activities.description: Connect the tactile letter to a story word.
activities.narrator_line: Feel this letter. Which word starts with it?
activities.reason: Connect the tactile target r to a familiar story word.
activities.feedback: Rabbit starts with r. Let’s follow Peter!
